description: This Java class implements the ProductOptionService interface, providing business logic for managing product options, including listing, retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting options within a store context. It interacts with data access objects and other service components.

classes.name: ProductOptionServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductOptionService for managing product options, extending generic entity service and using DAO for data interactions.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves list of product options for a specific store and language.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a read-only list of product options for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves product options by name for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product option after removing associated product attributes.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option by its code within a specific store.
